features.name: Recruitable field artillery batteries (player + AI lords)
features.summary: The player buys up to 2 field guns (6 types: 12-pdr Napoleon, 10-pdr Parrott, 3-inch Ordnance, 12/24-pdr howitzers, 6-pdr M1841) at a town foundry; each comes with a 3-man crew that joins the party. In field battles the guns are spawned as scene props in front of the player, crews walk to them and fire simulated cannonballs with splash damage and knock-down. Enemy lords' armies spawn 1-2 guns of their own.
features.mechanics: Campaign: menu:cannon_recruitment (from the town foundry option) -> add_cannon_crew increments party slots 381-386 (one counter per gun type, slot index computed by get_cannon_count_per_type) and party_add_members a faction-specific cannon_operator troop (get_cannon_operator_for_faction) x3; cap reg8=2 guns (get_cannon_count). refill_crew_members tops crews up to 3/gun at $100 each; disband options call remove_cannon_crew. Battle (lead_charge, also siege/village_raid templates): t27 (ti_after_mission_start +3s) finds high ground 9 battlegroups toward the enemy (find_high_ground_around_pos1_corrected) and, if the enemy is a lord party (party slot 0 == 13) not Native faction and whose signature troop (troop slot 374) is not mounted, spawn_cannon_pos2 spawns 1 (2 if the player owns guns) random cannon prop + 3 revolver-armed crew agents (division 8), storing crew in scene_prop slots 300-302 and the prop in trp_cannon_array. t29 spawns the player's guns (one prop per counter in slots 381-386, max 4) 10 m ahead of the player and binds existing crew agents via cf_connect_cannons_and_operators (agent slot 303 = bound gun, scripted destinations around the gun). t30 every 1s checks crews: gun manned (prop slot 305) if the loader plus one helper alive; otherwise survivors are released. t32/t33 pick targets and rotate the barrel (brute_rotate_direction/brute_rotation_check). t34 every 3s fires: unless the artillery division (8) has hold-fire ordered, spawns an mp_cannonball prop with target = target agent pos +/-10 m scatter, flight countdown = distance/100 (prop slot 306), reload 30-39 s (slot 308), smoke/flash/sound; enemy crews draw revolvers. t35 every 1s lands balls: AoE damage 35-85 (+5*(1+gun type)) multiplied at <=1 m, full <=2 m, half <=4 m, quarter <=5 m via agent_deliver_damage_to_agent from the loader, knock-down animation for unmounted humans within 5 m. [Source names] Kit credited to DrTomas ('####DrTomas constants', '##DrTomas Cannon script'). Mission triggers are named tuples in module_mission_templates.py 3522-5090 ('#### cannons start/end'): list `cannons` = cannons_count, cannons_spawn_enemy, cannons_spawn_freelancer, cannons_spawn, cannons_operation_check, cannons_select_targets, cannons_rotate_to_target, cannons_reload, cannons_shoot, cannons_balls_move; variants `cannons_siege`, `cannons_village`, `cannons_custom` (custom battles). Tunables (module_constants.py 2741-2780): cannon_cost 3000, cannon_count_per_party 2, cannon_count_per_side 4, operators_per_cannon 3, cannon_reload_timer 30, cannon_division 8, battle/siege entry-point constants (battle_cannon_entry_point_* 1/3/4, siege_cannon_entry_point_* 0/40).

features.name: WSE break_loop (opcode 8) in the imprisoned-companion traveller dialog
features.summary: The only non-vanilla opcode in ACW: two uses of opcode 8 inside the traveller dialog that tells you where an imprisoned companion is held. It is a real engine-extension statement (WSE/WSE2 loop break), not corrupt data; it only exits the town search early.
features.mechanics: dlg:2207 dlga_tavern_traveler_companion_location_tell -> tavern_traveler_pretalk (cond): when the companion is a prisoner and not in a party, try_for_range :l3 p_town_1..p_salt_mine; party_count_prisoners_of_type > 0 -> assign :l0 = :l3 -> opcode 8 with 0 operands, then try_end. Both occurrences sit at the identical 'found it, stop' position. Opcode 8 is absent from the tool's vanilla opcode table; in the WSE/WSE2 header it is the loop-break operation. Without WSE the statement is unknown to the engine (likely ignored or logged), so the loop would simply continue and report the LAST matching town instead of the first - harmless.

features.name: Timed AI battle plan, faction default formations and mounted-pistol auto-switch
features.summary: Enemy AI follows a timed script: at 2 s (and again at 25 s) its infantry and skirmishers advance a third of the way toward the player's largest group and dress into 4-rank lines, at 3 s cavalry is posted beside its own infantry line, at 20 s cavalry charges and at 90 s everyone charges. Each team's formation style is chosen by its faction, and mounted AI carrying pistols/carbines are kept on their firearm unless ordered to melee.
features.mechanics: $madsci_timer reset at ti_before_mission_start (t2), incremented by mst:lead_charge/t4 every 1 s. At 2/25 s: store_battlegroup_data, for each non-player team with infantry/archer battlegroups find a leader agent, get_biggest_enemy_group, place order position 1/3 of the distance plus 25 m lateral, team_give_order hold + form_archers / form_infantry (4 ranks, spacing 2). At 3 s: for each enemy team, take the first non-cavalry agent's position, point it toward the player, shift 1 m sideways and order the cavalry division (2) to hold there (beside its own line); at 20 s formation_end + charge for cavalry; at 90 s all divisions charge. t40 (once, 0.4 s) records each team's faction ($teamN_faction) and get_default_formation maps faction -> formation type (0 or 2). t51 every 4 s: mounted non-player agents with ammo, not hold-fire and not melee-only order, are switched to a wielded thrown/pistol/bow-type item (types 8/10/16) if they hold one.

features.summary: The custom-battle screen offers 35 historical battlefields (Manassas to Bentonville) and 38 historical generals with biographies; each battlefield loads at its historical time of day, some with fog, with artillery, colour-guards, war cry and bugles active.
features.mechanics: Native presentation game_custom_battle_designer (module_presentations.py ~380-810) extended: combo label of quick_battle_troops (trp_quick_battle_troop_1 .. trp_quick_battle_troops_end, 38 entries) with biography text; scene combo filled from civil_war_custom_battle_scenes_begin = scn_civ_custom_battle_manassas .. scn_civ_custom_battle_end (35 scenes) and other scene categories (random, camp, town, castle, village, plus a debug 'Scene ID' browser of all edit scenes). mst quick_battle_battle/quick_battle_siege append custom_flagbearers + common_vader_deathcam_custom + custom_battle_ai (madsci_custom_ai: the enemy team is ordered to charge about 1-2 s in, unless $g_quick_battle_game_type = 1) + custom_weather (madsci_weather: scene_set_day_time / set_fog_distance per scene in its condition block) + cannons_custom + EG3_Warcry_custom + bugle_calls_custom.
